comments.body: How do you acquire these shoes?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
These can be produced in Florence at the Chamber of Commerce's Craftsman. It's only accessible when:

The World Clock is set at 16th Century-P.2, 16th Century-P.3, or 16th Century-P.4
You have obtained and equipped Chrono Quest Adept of Ages titles from one of those three periods
You have EX equipment with Age effect (16th century) effect equipped

Recipe name: Dancing boots manufacture method
Ingredients:
Leather x10
Cotton Fabric x10
Leather Cord x10
Costs: Handicrafts Contribution 200 points + 60k ducats per production.

On to the shoes. Stats:

Sundries Trading +1
2k fame to equip, color-custom

Cheers.
